scope: Original and C draft agree with independent handshake model on poll consumption, ordered halfword sends, permanent halt or pre-BIOS handoff. Poll results are synthetic; decompression and physical link timing are not validated. Optional handoff check compares r0-r12 and CPSR, seeds r4-r12, and verifies the known candidate SP decrement of four; LR and halt-state registers are excluded. Candidate does not byte-match.
